independentCalculator.finding: Critical damage pool caps victims at two and retains native skill hit multiplicity; initial SP subtracts selected talent SP. This independent calculator does not establish executable SplashDamage selector/coefficient dispatch or frame parity; no calculator implementation is reused.

runtimeMapping.trait: Source kill_to_add_cost credits selected trait cost1 only on an actual owned enemy kill, including the talent extra victim. Root Charger retreat path refunds source raw/base cost with ratio1 and original-cost cap1, never redeploy-inflated paid cost or automatic death.
runtimeMapping.normal: Native ground single direct Physical/Melee CAST attack. First engagement uses original Attack_Begin .167 then Attack_Loop .267; source attack cap1, animation-controller cap-1 retained separately. Ordinary disengagement uses literal Attack_End and resets first-only begin.
runtimeMapping.s1: All selected thirty-five seconds, additive ATK percentage and ASPD; retains ordinary direct attack and per-damage talent.
runtimeMapping.s2: One selected stored charge causes two separately mitigated locked-input Physical strikes at literal Skill(.267,.433), or Front DOWN Skill_Down. Unborn foreign accepted control cancels; normal true-dead pre-emission input refund only, never own-hit death/emitted damage or live invalid input. Source noSP held through the second original event, canceled release clears it. Tail has its own captured deployment/control epoch and target lifetime; one family attack lifecycle.
runtimeMapping.s3: Source twenty-second ATK/DEF percentage, additive block1, and BAT PERCENTAGE+.7, preserving independent external BAT percentages/flat terms. Native loop three separately mitigated events .467/.567/.667, or Front DOWN loop. Three per-calculated-damage talent rolls, single ordinary attack lifecycle; no inherited three simultaneous hits or once-burst crit.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Native ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE IsBlackboardZero avoid_dup_trigger_lock0 then per-spell Dice, pre-mitigation AtkScaleUp, SplashDamage SOURCE/excludeTARGET/PHYSICAL/MELEE/NORMAL. Extra receipt sets explicit duplicate lock and stays an ordinary attack receipt with separate mitigation/dodge/kill credit. Bounded extra selector: one other legal victim in current owner range, ordinary enemy priority; same selected spell coefficient before native talent scale.
runtimeMapping.talent2: Source categoryMask512 native deck buff modify_sp[born] grants selected6/8 SP once per allied PIONEER operator deployment from squad records, including self/support/bench source. Uses ordinary gainSp with forceFlagfalse; not reliant on Bagpipe deployment, no duplicate per-unit aura.

verificationLimits: Original executable C# ability/FSM/attribute dispatch has not been recovered. Literal selectors, events, flags and all ranks remain preserved; no recorded-client frame parity is claimed.

SplashDamage serializes SOURCE/excludeTARGET/NORMAL/MELEE but no victim range/count/order/coefficient calculation. One additional victim follows primary description; current owner range, ordinary priority and same selected spell ATK scale before talent scale are explicit bounded interpretations, not native selector proof. Independent calculator two-victim cap/multihit pool corroboration does not recover native dispatch.

Normal first-only Attack_Begin controller uses maxAnimScale-1, while its MeleeAttack cap1 applies to loop release. Adapter samples unrestricted begin ASPD and capped loop ASPD separately; exact native cooldown/clip state handoff/disengagement end-clock ordering remains unrecovered.

S3 unused Skill_2_Begin/End aliases are retained but no source binding proving gameplay delay was recovered. Adapter does not invent an extra startup lock; literal Skill_2_Loop events and source twenty-second mode are bound directly.

Source INPUT1 S2 retains the original selected victim through its two events; native invalid living input/out-of-range selector execution and mode-detach tail ordering are unrecovered. Already released family tails continue after nominal S3 mode end when still legal, but foreign control/withdrawal/death cancels unborn events.

Source allowSpRecoveryWhenAffecting0 is bound from S2 timed startup through its last original event, and cleared on accepted interruption/refund. Exact native canceled pending-state reentry and full animation-end affecting phase remain unrecovered.

Source born deck SP applies via regular deploy notification, preserving forceFlagfalse ordinary gain gate. Native profession enum and owner-born versus automatic deploy-skill ordering remain a bounded dispatcher map; category512 agrees with pinned PIONEER description.

ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE maps to synchronous pre-mitigation hit callbacks; other-source modifier ordering and SplashDamage-before-primary kill ordering are retained as the selected action order, but native executable priority/cancellation masks are not recovered.
Original Unity particle/audio keys are retained identifiers only; feedback effects are approximate.
